value.rationale: The centralizer of a minimal nilpotent is a canonical small noncommutative nilpotent algebra. The nilradical is an embedded deformation-theoretic feature wholly absent from the known reduced two-plane description, with exact exponentially growing transverse length and a complete filtration for arbitrary tuple length. This is a meaningful scheme-theoretic classification, not a routine finite-field table or isolated invariant.
